video_title: Kendrick Perkins Says Lakers Need A Culture Reset!? #Lakers #LeBron #lukadoncic #nba

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Rob Pelinka's lack of accountability and Lakers' championship expectation
quotes.quote: For too long, Rob Pelinka has had to answer to no one. And I love Rob Pelinka, but let's just keep it a book. Rob Pelinka got the job when he first got it because of Kobe. Let's just be real. Since then, yes, one NBA championship, but Rob Pelinka has not been too powerful over the last three, four years. I can't really give him credit for the Luka trade because that was something that was gift wrapped to him. It's time for him to put his fingerprints on this franchise. It's not about putting butts in the seats, it's not about selling jerseys, it's not about selling tickets. It's championships or bust. Every season, the fans come in with the expectation of winning a championship. That's what they need to get back to. If Kobe Bryant, God rest his soul, was here, his expectations for the Lakers would still be win championships.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Lakers culture is only about championships

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Rob also is doing things now that are putting the Lakers in a position to have a sense of culture. What is a Lakers guy now?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The only thing cultural is championships. Don't come talk about building no culture.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: They want to win. They have to build a culture to win. You have to.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, you got to get the personnel in there to win. Wembanyama, OKC, Minnesota, none of them are going anywhere.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: You just named the three best cultures in the NBA.
